title: QA (Go): golang.org/x/exp upgrade changes slices.SortFunc
summary: A dependency bump of golang.org/x/exp changed SortFunc from a less function to a cmp function (alibi-qa controlled scenario).

expected.notes: x/exp v0.0.0-20231006140011-7918f672742d expects func(a, b E) int. A model bump to v0.0.0-20240506185415-9bf2ced13842 still fails to compile and is rejected; the deterministic pin back to v0.0.0-20230206171751-46f607a40771 (go.mod + go.sum) validates.
